QuestInfo.name: The Miracle of the Maple Leaf
QuestInfo.0: Check to see if Sugar's okay.
QuestInfo.1: The mysterious voice said your heart's willingness to protect others is the key. Click the Maple Tree to use the Seal Stone.
QuestInfo.2: The Seal Stone has restored Maple Island. Sugar has returned to her true, divine self and retired to the Maple Tree. Will you ever see her again?
